customer_type.description: Whether the property is residential or commercial

contact_preference.description: Whether the customer prefers a call or text when the technician is on the way

to_number.description: The phone number that was called (tracking number)

is_homeowner.description: Whether the customer owns the home. Yes or No.

issue_description.description: Description of the plumbing issue the customer is experiencing

appointment_time.description: Preferred date and time for the service appointment

address.description: Service address where the plumber needs to come

promotional_emails.description: Whether the customer gives permission for promotional emails. Yes or No.

is_emergency.description: True if the customer said it is an emergency, false otherwise

is_excavation.description: Set to true if Sarah identified the issue as requiring excavation work during the call. Set to false for all standard plumbing jobs. Pass as boolean, not string.

phone.description: Primary phone number of the customer

customer_id.description: Customer ID from check_service_area. Only pass if found=true AND caller confirmed they are that customer.
